name: Far East Smarter Energy Co., Ltd.
summary: Far East Smarter Energy Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides smart energy and digital smart city services in China and internationally. It operates through three segments: Smart Cable Network/Electric Power; Smart Battery Energy Storage/Computing Power AI; and Smart Airport. The company researches, develops, produces, and sells cables, including AI computing power, offshore, nuclear-grade, new energy vehicle charging, and embedded chip cables, as well as cables for robots.
